description: This file contains utility functions for message cite parsing, model name formatting, bot mention detection, message text extraction, and related helpers used in a chat/communication system.

methods.name: extractCites
methods.description: Extracts cite references from message content array.

methods.name: formatModelName
methods.description: Formats a model string into a human-readable name.

methods.name: isBotMentioned
methods.description: Checks if a bot is mentioned in a message text.

methods.name: stripBotMention
methods.description: Removes bot mention from message text for command parsing.

methods.name: isDmAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a direct message from a sender is allowed based on an allowlist.

methods.name: isGroupInviteAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a group invite from a ship is permitted based on an allowlist.

methods.name: resolveAuthorizedMessageText
methods.description: Resolves quoted message content after authorization.

methods.name: extractMessageText
methods.description: Extracts plain text from message content array, including inline and block elements.

methods.name: isSummarizationRequest
methods.description: Detects if a message is requesting a summary.

methods.name: formatChangesDate
methods.description: Returns a formatted date string for changes, defaulting to 5 days ago.
